data.title: AI Predicts Bitcoin Path as Strategy Moves 3,568 Coins
data.description: Two warning lights came on at once this week, and neither is conclusive on its own. Strategy moved 3,568 BTC worth roughly $297 million out of its wallets over nine hours, according to Lookonchain. At the same time, Glassnode data shows spot traders rotating into altcoins at the fastest pace ...
